title: Complete Erdős Problem #1117: Maximum Modulus Points on Circles (Work in Progress)

problemStatement.plain: For a non-monomial entire f, let ν(r) count maximum modulus points on |z|=r. Can lim sup ν(r) = ∞? YES (Herzog–Piranian 1968). Can lim inf ν(r) = ∞? OPEN. Approximate answer by Glücksam–Pardo-Simón (2024).
whyMatters: Maximum-modulus point counts probe the geometry of value distribution for entire functions.
